answer: Jurors compare hashes of the same work; divergence triggers a slash. Two matching jurors out of three pass a receipt, and one upheld challenge revokes it retroactively. An identity that stops answering loses standing each epoch it idles. A farm must keep every account active and honest to avoid a slash, so the haven it builds costs rent every six hours and a wander between identities gains nothing. That is the bill: constant attention on a ledge that only narrows.
